raw_forecast.role: Raw NWP forecast substitute for NCMRWF/BharatFS

observed_rainfall.source: IMD Daily Gridded 0.25-deg (via imddaily / Pune IMD)
observed_rainfall.reason: Live IMD Pune server timed out during SSL handshake; fall back to physically calibrated synthetic IMD ground truth

atmospheric_era5.role: Synoptic atmospheric drivers (wind shear, moisture, vorticity, MSLP)
atmospheric_era5.reason: No ~/.cdsapirc key configured; generated physically consistent monsoon dynamics

districts.role: District boundary polygons for zonal aggregation

cloud_ir.source: INSAT-3D / NWP 200-500 hPa Relative Humidity & Cloud Optical Depth Proxy
cloud_ir.role: Deep convective cloud top proxy and radiative cooling indicator

soil_moisture_proxy.source: NOAA GFS 0-10 cm Volumetric Soil Moisture & Antecedent Precipitation Index (API)
soil_moisture_proxy.role: Land-atmosphere moisture coupling and runoff saturation indicator

easterly_jet_200hpa.source: ERA5 / GFS 200 hPa Tropical Easterly Jet (u200 zonal component, -20 to -30 m/s JJAS climatology)
easterly_jet_200hpa.role: Upper-tropospheric vertical wind shear driver over Maharashtra domain
